upright_anchor.basis: User-presented natural upright pose. No independent gravity-vertical instrument is recorded.

capture.basis: User-presented natural upright pose. No independent gravity-vertical instrument is recorded.

vs_original_upright.interpretation: Raw native count change minus raw-camera pose change. Saved encoder reference changes cancel by using counts. No recalibration or encoder-only attribution.

excluded.reason: Recovery/rest session, not an AUTO or BAL performance recording.
Recovery/rest session, not an AUTO or BAL performance recording.
User confirmed pole handling during initial rest; aborted before any gain write or AUTO. Excluded from performance and calibration.

timeline: Two BW8 AUTO runs sustained BAL after upright reference520→533 with unchanged gains. User then handled the pole; one BW6 run and a later BW8 run after fullHOME did not sustain BAL. These later failures prevent attributing success/failure solely to bandwidth. Failed handled attempt was excluded before gain write or AUTO.

frozen_lag.interpretation: Fixed old-cohort alignment proxy only; changed view/processing may change latency. Zero and±10ms sensitivity is reported for postcapture data. No calibrated exposure latency claim.

method.camera_angle: atan2(bob_x-pivot_x,pivot_y-bob_y), subtract median from user upright-check-02 only for the new unchanged-camera cohort. No camera fusion/calibrated theta or mirrored encoder is used.
method.geometry: Camera moved before upright-check-02. Same view confirmed for direct BAL10 and first two533 BW8 runs; later post-handling orientation is unverified and anchored figures are conditional. This anchor is never applied to old520 frames. Natural upright is not independent gravity metrology.
method.filters: Base loader: valid measured source, confidence>=0.8, no stale/error, source/collector age<=150ms, finite marker geometry, length within20% of trial median. Every rejected frame breaks camera segments; camera gaps>75ms and telemetry gaps>30ms break interpolation/continuity.
method.native_info: encoder_raw_age_us measures duration since raw count last changed, never acquisition freshness. INFO native counts and STATE reconstructed counts remain separate.
method.jitter: Demanded/governed acceleration RMS, adjacent total variation and first-difference rate RMS are descriptive jitter proxies, not physical cart accelerometry or an independently measured bandwidth.
method.windows: First uninterrupted native BAL segment only. Postcapture window starts2s after entry; first/last5s comparisons are labeled if overlapping. Centering criterion is separate from balance state.
method.uncertainty: Temporally correlated samples; no confidence intervals or acceptance promotion. Step counts do not independently verify physical cart displacement.
